description: The SDK's HTTP client modules (such as `apache-client` and `netty-nio-client`), metric publishers, high-level libraries (such as `s3-transfer-manager` and `dynamodb-enhanced`), `utils`, `utils-lite`, `http-client-spi`, and `codegen` now include a generated `META-INF/software.amazon.awssdk/<artifactId>/version.properties` resource whose `version` key contains the SDK minor version (for example `2.56.x`).
